scope: Final bounded source-only review of explicit native-binding observation projection, typed pure-data binary/readback/roundtrip/SHA, summary persistence and cleanup/exit failure boundaries. No parser/engine, source edit, materialization or native result.

resolved_prior_findings.observation: Optional level WeakRef is constructed only for valid level, checked for null before get_ref, while owned Game is still normally freed and its own WeakRef verified.

observations.result: Each per-tick trace projects recognized Hero/static-floor/collision-shape/Box/Capsule references before later cleanup. Metadata keeps explicit instance/script/path/world/transform/collision dimensions with reconstructible:false. Native Vector/Rect/Basis/Transform/scalar/path values remain native Variants; this is an explicit projection, not a lossless runtime Object graph or campaign/native save.

Released/unrecognized Object references and Callable/RID/Signal values set persistent evidence_error; positive difference and exit0 require it empty. No such handles are intentionally serialized as live runtime authority.

Dictionary keys are retained rather than recursively projected. Selected native response/proof/lease/action dictionaries use primitive/String keys; no actual selected handle-key input found. This review makes no claim that arbitrary Variant graphs are a supported input domain.

Raw trace writer computes SHA256, flushes, reads original file bytes, compares exact bytes and readback SHA, then requires bytes_to_var/var_to_bytes roundtrip equality. Decode uses ordinary safe nonobject Variant decoding. A write/open/readback/hash/roundtrip failure produces accepted:false.

Options refuse existing summary or raw trace in unique TEST namespace. Raw persistence is capped at128MiB without truncating paths. Evidence/write/cleanup/assertion failures deny fixed_difference and exit0. Summary is primitive metadata plus raw receipt and requires exact text readback and SHA before a success exit.

Completion latches before normal exit/free, verifies Game/optional level release, and includes cleanup assertions before computing final difference. Watchdog/bootstrap refusal or missing candidate cannot inherit success from a partial response; typed trace/raw write failures remain nonpassing.

precision_limits: var_to_bytes preserves the pure native Variant graph produced after explicit binding projection, not ephemeral runtime Object identity or a restorable native save.
No claim of native executable parser validity, dictionary serialization behavior or successful file write/roundtrip is made without Root execution.
Complete gameplay proof/held-union/cadence analysis belongs to the parallel native source review, not this custody pass.
Only exact frozen bf57 source is reviewed; later modifications require their own relevant delta review.
